notes: Exactly 16 credits is a hard requirement.
No fixed meeting may start before 09:30 or end after 15:50.
CHEM231 and CHEM232 must remain together.
ENES210 and INST155 stay in the schedule and are treated as having no fixed meeting for conflict scoring.
BSCI331 and BIOM301 may replace one 3-credit current course, normally COMM107 or BSCI207, only when the resulting 16-credit schedule scores materially better.

A non-Stocker CHEM231 section must beat the current schedule by a much larger margin.

FSOC alternatives are monitored broadly but an alert is allowed only for instructors explicitly vetted as clearly easier/lower-workload than Lori Sefton in INAG110. Unknown instructors are suppressed until vetted.
Open seat alone never triggers an alert; the opening must create a materially better exact-16-credit schedule.
